blocks:
What is going on? My body doesn't move as it should... I must hurry to
Cosmos!

Manikins... Shadow entities employed by Chaos's forces as troops. Such
shallow imitations have no chance against me.

What manner of fiend is that? It seems unlike the foes I've faced thus
far.

Cosmos...? Cosmos! I must find her... I have no time for these
interruptions!

I have been defeated by Chaos. The god of discord, Chaos... His brutal
powers destroyed the balance of all things, threatening the fabric of reality
itself.

All existence is on the brink of doom. Ten of you remain--and you are
the last hope left to this world. I implore you. Obtain the light that even in
a broken world could never fade-- the light of the crystals. The crystals
embody the strength to face despair. With ten gathered, there is hope yet to
save the world. The path to your crystal will be perilous... and different for
each and every one of you. But you must believe in and follow your own path.
Even if you know not where that path leads...
Not a problem. I've always gotten by on my own.

If the treasure were really that easy to find, it wouldn't be a
treasure hunt, would it?

No horsing around, though. This isn't the time for games. It's time for
some serious fun.

You don't have to worry. I'm here with you. If it gets scary, just believe
in me!

The paths to our crystals may be different for each of us. But we've
strength in our allies.
And if we put that strength together, we'll have nothing to fear.

I don't know. The god, Chaos, is leading his forces of disorder-- and
they're headed straight for us. But I'm ready for whatever comes my way.
The tougher the enemy, the more fired up I get!

Though what remains of this world is on the verge of collapses... I
must hold it together until you find your crystals... Forgive me... I want to
be with you... But allow me to rest... Then soon...

Cosmos... Your radiant light shall always be with us.

[Cosmos teleports away. The heroes are all shown setting off on their
journeys, WoL depicted last. The Dissidia Final Fantasy logo comes up again]

--------------Destiny Odysseys-------------- [5.0De]
1) Destiny Odyssey I [5.1De]

The world is shrouded in darkness.
It seems that Chaos's shadows would engulf all...
But light is not gone.
The crystals, shining even in the depths of despair--
It is said that hope can be restored
if the ten surviving warriors can take hold of them.
Now the journey begins for the Warrior of Light...

-The Guiding Light-

[The setting is Chaos's place]
Chaos: "I am the god of discord--destined to rule this world. Am I not?

Indeed. Our objective is clear: to defeat Cosmos and bring chaos to
the world.

The conflict will be brought to an end as soon as I regain my lost
strength. It is only a matter of time until all the pieces are in place for
victory. And yet... Something does not feel right. Garland, are your words
truly worthy of my trust?
I feel the presence of evil... Does anyone dare stand in my way?
I've no time to waste. I must hurry, for Cosmos...

Cosmos... We have heard your wish, and we shall fulfill it. With crystals
in our hands, we shall bring hope to the world--
And where do you think you're going?
Do you dare run from a battle?
I do not intend to run from anything.
Then let us start. Destiny is at hand. We might as well enjoy it!
You truly think that you can save this world?
That is precisely our mission. Our hopes have not been crushed yet.

What a fool. What you hope for is nothing but an illusion. Pursue it,
and it will run. You may draw near, but never obtain it.

Eventually you will see... the truth behind this conflict... and the
world will betray you!
No matter what becomes of the world... the light will always be with us.
My comrades... What's wrong? Did something happen?

He headed for the enemy's lair alone; he said something precious of his
was stolen.
No, leave this to me. You must attend to other duties.

Cecil, please listen. Your brother knows something about this world. You
must determine if he can be trusted. That is your current role.

Cecil, that last fight left you in bad shape. Let's listen to him,
okay?

...Understood. Please look after Firion. And may the goddess light
your path!

To go so far into enemy territory alone... He must have lost something
very dear.

That was a rather odd enemy... So the manikins come in different
varieties. But never mind that. Is Firion just ahead?
Firion! You've fought well. Leave the rest to me.

You must go and look after our comrades to keep their paths to the
crystals open.
A fresh one. You won't get your crystal fighting against me.
Then why do you stand in my way?
You have injured one of my comrades.

And you want revenge, I take it. So, on a whim, you would risk
your life--
Let us begin, and see this put to rest.

Not bad at all... But I now realize there is only one who could
defeat me.
What in the world are you--

I have one question for you. For what reason do you take up that
blade?
To obtain the crystal, and put an end to the conflict.

So you fight to end the fighting... You have a long road ahead.
Do you really expect to end the conflict after all your battles?
However long the road, each battle brings me closer.

I think not. You don't wish an end to the fighting. You find
pleasure in it, just as I do.
(The wild rose...) (That must be what Firion came for...)
You and I are the same-- entities befitting this closed world.
The time has come. I must face him and fulfill my obligation.
(What does the enemy know about this world? ...No use worrying.)
For now, I must continue my quest for the crystal.
Whatever truths the enemy know, I possess even firmer convictions.

Traveler of time... When the need arises, flames of courage
shall be yours.
Do you think I don't notice your presence? Why not just show yourself?

Where are you headed? Might you still be in search of your
precious crystal?

The crystals are indeed our goal. I do not intend to stop until I find
mine.

Why don't you just give up? The crystals are nothing more than the
fabrication of a fallen goddess. To so willingly risk your life over such
things is beyond ridiculous.

If you have no business with me, you should leave now. The world's time
runs short. There is not a moment to waste with the likes of you.

You are bold for one so young... Then have it your way. It is time
for you to face the harshness of reality!

Do you think...your victory means the end? Nothing you do will ever
matter. Your strength is not enough to save the world, no matter how hard you
try.

Your deceptions fail you. I have comrades who are in search of their own
crystals.

Those comrades that you speak of are suffering. Some do not yet
know why they fight, while others stand alone, having lost faith in their
comrades. When this conflict comes to an end... all you will gain is utter
despair. You will not find hope. You will not find a future!

(It is true, I have not yet found a way to the crystal,) (nor do I know
what the future holds...)
But the future... is yet to come.
Wait, could that be... Squall? You travel alone?

To obtain the crystal, each one of us must confront his real enemy by
himself. Cosmos told me that.
You are fully aware of what your proposed actions imply?
I am. As long as the crystals shine, they will survive.
You would risk everything. Such conduct is unbecoming of a goddess.

Discord or harmony...the victor matters not. The dragon arises; the
cycle continues. The gods will live again, as will their champions, and
conflict will begin anew. Yet, if the cycle itself is as transient as the lives
trapped within it... Think long upon this, goddess. If you lose this gamble,
your warriors will never rise again.
Then, a true ending means neverending discord...a perpetual darkness?
Indeed. The world would fall into eternal despair.
(What is this...? Could it be Chaos? Or another--)

Beyond this point, incredible danger awaits. The evils that lurk are
great and many.

It is better if the foes are in one place. I may be able to find clues to
the crystal.
There is a difference between bravery and recklessness.

As there is a difference between cautious and cowardly. Even in the
direst circumstances, there will always be a way. You were the one who taught
me that. When all hope seemed lost for this world, you showed me the way. That
as long as we do not give up, there is always something we can do. That there
is yet hope for those of us who are left. I have made a vow...to obtain the
crystal and save the world. That vow gives me strength.

I understand your determination. Then I shall make a vow... to believe
in all of you until the end...

Cosmos... That which we have all sworn to... shall always be my guiding
light.

This world has not yet lost all hope. Though its glow wanes, my
convictions shall not!

WoL: "Was that a voice I heard? I have felt this presence before...

That was quite the performance. But I believe you owe us now. It's
thanks to your antics that we lost that Bartz character.

(Bartz? What was he doing here? But wait...) It is very much like him
to escape in the midst of this mayhem.

He is a lucky one, indeed. But surely you must be aware by now...
Victory is unobtainable for you in this battle. But your prowess with the light
should not go to waste. What would you say to using your powers for me? Your
loyalty will not go unrewarded.
Your search is over. This crystal shall be yours to keep.
I see. So that was your plan.

Oh... So you would your only hope and crush it? The crystals--were
they not what you were after?

I have vowed to put an end to this conflict with my own hands. It is for
that reason that I must find the crystal by myself. It is not charity I should
receive from the enemy. That was nothing but an imitation.
And I suppose your determination is true.

Your resolve to end the conflict is most impressive. But will you
still be as determined after you know the truth?
Looks like it's my turn now...

Why are you so surprised? As long as you live, I will keep coming
back to life. That is the destiny this world has chosen for us.
If the truth behind the conflict is what you seek...come find me.
Wait! The truth behind the conflict...?

So... You finally seem ready to learn the whole truth. But now you
are the only champion without his crystal. Do not think you can defeat me when
you have nothing to prove your worth!

Nothing? I have the light, and that is enough. I remain steadfast in my
convictions, no matter how many times I must fight you!

As time runs its course, men like you can only travel the paths given
you by fate. But my power surpasses time. And with it, I will destroy you. You
will meet your end here, while I will live forever!

Prepare yourself, Garland... If destiny calls us to fight, then I welcome
it!
To learn the truth, and put an end to the conflict.

Your foolish efforts amount to naught. We are trapped in eternal
conflict... A cycle of battle without end.

Indeed. As the conflict between the gods carries on for all eternity,
so our battles will also be repeated forever and ever! That is the truth of
this world! We cannot escape this fate! Far better for you to rid yourself of
any hope. It is time for you to accept the cycle and embrace combat's grim
pleasure!

You are bound by the chains of destiny and steeped in despair. And for
that, I pity you. Indeed, we have repeated our battles time and time again. You
could say that we have been caught in the cycle of battle. But now that I know
the truth, I can overcome it. All that is left to do now is fight to end the
cycle!

You can defeat me here, but that would only be another step in the
cycle!

Whatever destiny the world may hold for me, I can never give up! This
battle shall come to an end, and I shall save you, too!
You? Save me? I have heard enough nonsense!
This is the cycle of battle!

We will never come to accept one another. We shall always be in
conflict!

So you have obtained it. The crystal holds the power to sever the
shackles of time.
Then it has the power to bring this conflict to a close.
And even put an end to the gods' existence.

What would happen to the gods if all the crystals were gathered? What
would happen to the world if its cycle of conflicts was suddenly broken? Not
even the gods could foresee the bedlam that awaits... We shall meet again-- in
the near future!

(The cycle is not yet over.) (I will have to face Garland again) (unless
we win the real conflict.) (But...)
Looks like you finally got it.
Of course! It was a piece of cake.
So now we all have our crystals. We should get going!
Yes. Let us hurry. Cosmos is waiting.

(No matter how many times darkness threatens to swallow the world--)
(the light will always be with us.)

Well, if it isn't the god of destruction. Have you regained your
powers?

Ah, so you already know. In truth, the real plan has yet to be
executed.

You need only focus on your duty. I shall be the author of this
tale's end.

There is no future for the bystander. As there is naught he can
defend.
It is all an endless dream. Yet still...
The fantasy must come to an end...

It's the wild rose. (Oh yeah. That's right...) (The enemy
stole it from me that time...)
So, tell me all about the wild rose!
Break time's over. We should get going soon.

Once I deal with my old man and find my crystal, I'll make you tell
me.
Firion, what's your goal in life?

You know, to become the world's best swordsman! Or, there's a guy you
just have to beat! Like Cloud and Cecil, a goal to strive for as you go down
your own path! You gotta have one to make it through what we're facing.

Right now, all I can think of is to end the conflict, no matter what
it takes.
In times like these, you just gotta let yourself go!

Of course, with the enemies so numerous, ending this conflict will be
no small feat...

It doesn't matter how many there are. All we have to do is shoot for
the goal!
You're right. Let us choose our course wisely.
That's what I like about you, Firion! So...what's the wild rose, huh?
Heh... I was just thinking about that myself.
No idea... It was here when I woke up. Cosmos, do you know?

I do not. But I do sense something special about it. It seems to have
come from a distant past...
Wild rose... Just saying the name gives me a sense of nostalgia...

His feelings bloom within him. Was the flower your idea? I hope you
realize that no amount of trickery will give them more time.
The past is past. I need only create a new future.
Hoping you can save them this time?
There are too many of them... Tidus, what do you say we split up?
There is something to be learned from how light he is on his feet...
Well, that's that. Tidus! Where are you?
Don't know where he is, but he's fine!
Hold on. You're Tidus's father, aren't you? What did you do to him?

Didn't do a damned thing. I've been told there's no point in me
fighting him yet.

Tidus has been looking forward to settling things with you. Don't tell
me you ran from the fight.

That wasn't funny, kid. Everyone's getting in my way, and it's kinda
ticking me off. Think I'll take it out on you!
You're not half bad! Come on. We're not done yet!

I realized something as I fought you. The one you really want to fight
isn't me. It's Tidus! Why use me as a substitute when you know he's determined
to face you?

Here's another kid who thinks he knows it all. But you sure know how to
hit a guy where it hurts.

I finally see where I'm supposed to go, thanks to all your meddling.
You know, when you're having a bad day, you just gotta let yourself go!
I get it now. Like father, like son. What a resemblance.
So you fought my old man, right? What did you think?

This may sound odd...but the look in his eyes almost made me forget he
was with Chaos.

Are you alright? You had best stay focused. There are plenty more
enemies ahead.
Don't worry about me. I'm doing fine. No, great!

I cannot answer your call, but I can save you from danger. Allow
me to lend you my powers.

I, er, I don't know... Um, what kind of 'powers' are we talking
about?
Come to me, Firion. I don't enjoy being teased...
So Tidus, what's YOUR goal in life?

A goal to strive for as you go down your own path--you have one,
right? It was only because you encouraged Cecil that he was able to move
forward. Are you satisfied with standing still?
Sorry for being so selfish, but I gotta do this...
Don't worry about it. It's the story you have to tell.
I'm gonna settle things with my old man.
So we go our separate ways.

It looks like you are all alone. Have all your friends abandoned
you?
Emperor! They have only gone to do what they must!
Oh? Then do you know what it is that you must do?
Of course I do! I must bring an end to this conflict!

Then we should teach him a lesson... on the futility of wishing for
an end.
Did I not say it was futile?

You are in the midst of a battle that has been fought between the
gods for ages. What do you possibly think you could do?

How pathetic. I'm afraid your dream of obtaining the crystals will
never become reality. Even the efforts of your friends will all be for naught.

I will not let their struggles be wasted. I will obtain the crystal,
and bring an end to this--

That is why you are weak. You only fight because you are told to. You
are nothing but Cosmos's tool.
Cloud, Cecil, and Tidus have each obtained their cyrstals.
They've done it... They've really done it!
Yes. Because they never stopped walking down the paths they chose.

I...never had a specific objective I could call my own... like
winning against my father, or winning alongside my brother. I just wanted to
bring an end to the conflict. It's like the Emperor said. I'm only a tool
without a will of my own.

That is untrue. You do have a goal. A dream that you have kept inside
your heart for a long time.

But my dream is nothing special. It's more like...just a childish
dream.
Tell me your dream-- and the future you wish for in your heart.

Wild roses... My dream is a world filled with wild roses. When the
battle is over, I want to fill the world with flowers. A world where we can
overcome what we have lost, where even the rain and the wind can provide us
with strength...

It's a beautiful dream. A dream that was born out of none other than
you. If you were a mere tool, you would not have had such a dream.

Cosmos... You're right. It is my dream. And it's up to me to seize
it.
I wish I could have such a dream...

(Many people lose their lives in times of war... They may die trying to
protect friends, or trying to give strength to others. But in the end, they
die. And there are others who lose hope, and grieve...)

A future where happiness blooms like a wild rose... That's what I'm
fighting for!
I must press onward... For Cosmos's dream...and my own!
What does an aimless tool of war want with me?
I am not just a tool. I fight in order to make my dream come true!
What's the matter? Are you done dreaming?
You've gone far enough on your own.
A friend's dream is our dream... We'll defend it together!
Cecil and Terra should be joining us soon, but--
Show us the rest of your dream.
That's right! We'll all be waiting for you.

Always the same desires, the same aims... Mere puppets who cannot
see their own strings.

And again, you are saved by the light. Tell me, is your will so
much stronger than the truth?
... Your words matter not. All is nothing against the 'great will.'

Everyone has supported me all this time... I won't keep them waiting
any longer! I must succeed!
I must carve my own path!
I will not lose to one who calls me a tool of war!

You and your pathetic dream. I should erase such flights of fancy.
You're far better off as just a tool.

Impossible. I have friends who share my dream. As long as my friends
are here, the dream will never fade. You could never erase our hopes for the
future!
In that case--I shall simply make everything mine.
You should have disposed of your fantasy and accepted me as master.
There is no meaning in strength only used to hurt others.
What will an insect like you do?

Believe in the future-- And persist in the present. That's what I'll
do!

This isn't over. Just you wait. Once you see how your dreams are
crushed, you will be begging for my reign!

(Perhaps the battle has just begun.) (In that case, let us keep
dreaming.) (A world full of wild roses--) (Along with my friends, I'll make it
come true.) It will come true. Someday!

You think I'm outsmarting myself?" [chuckles] "I tire of your chirps,
ignorant fool!

I've lost interest.

[He flies away. Garland looks at Jecht]
Garland: "Surely you have others to spar with.

Crystals...have the power to break through despair, huh? I wonder what
they look like.

Do you think we can find them? What if we do find them, but we still
can't save the world?

Gods always have a habit of sounding pretentious, don't they? There's no
proof that Cosmos is telling the truth, but we don't know that she's wrong,
either. Anyway, our only choice is to believe and move forward. Let's start
with what we can do.

Standing around here isn't going to give us any answers. Come on, let's
get moving. You don't need to worry. I'm going to figure this all out.
Look...the path ahead is hidden. Could enemies be hiding there? Or...

Could be an ambush, could be treasure. Until we know, we'll have to be
careful.
Is that girl truly worth the trouble?
Ab-so-lute-ly! Her powers are the real deal!
Then we will take your word. We shall soon see how strong she is.

You won't regret it...as long as she performs as well as she did
before.

Oops, just talking to myself! Before, after, now, all the same! Now,
off you go! Happy fighting!
I sense many enemies here, too. Are we going to be alright?

You just have to take a good look at the enemy before going into battle.
Based on their equipment, you can figure out their weakness--the spell or the
sword.
I feel something... Something very powerful from that direction...
Do you think it's a crystal?
I can't tell. It's just a strong presence.

Something about this doesn't feel right. I don't think we should get
any closer.

Terra, even if it isn't a crystal, we might find some clues. It's alright.
I can handle any enemy that comes our way.

Chaos's puppets may be strong, but they're just big lunkheads. And I've
got something they don't... Right here, if you know what I mean.
Are you sure about this? I think the enemies are getting stronger...

There's nothing to worry about, Terra. It'd be reckless to just dive in,
but watch carefully, and we'll find an opening." Manikins are brainless, but
we're not! Use your head, and there's nothing to be scared of.
You're so strong. I envy your courage.

Whenever your heart shatters, Flames of Rebirth shall protect
you.
It's still up ahead... Watch out!

I come out here to kill the time, and what do I find but a woman and
child.
(No way I can look after Terra while fighting him. I've got an idea...)
C-could you possibly let us go, sir?

Our strength is no match to yours. We're hardly worth your time. I think
you'd be much better off finding a stronger opponent to fight. Unless you're
the cowardly type who only picks on those weaker than yourself...

I suppose there is no point in sending harmless insects to the void.
Very well. I will let you go. But keep this in mind, little worm. The crystals
shun the unworthy hands of those without valor.

Well, that was easy! Of course, even if he came for us, I would have run.
I don't fight against anyone unless I know I can win.
What do you mean by that?

It seemed like he let us go on purpose. He sort of even gave you advice
when you wouldn't fight him...

You mean the 'those without valor' line? Fighting against someone you
can't beat isn't a sign of valor. It's simply being reckless!

Then I'll prove it to you by getting the crystal. That'll show I'm not
'without valor.' Let's go. Do you still feel the presence?

The girl awakens to the light. Your plans have come to nothing,
Kefka.
Nothing? Are you blind or just stupid? You saw her power firsthand!

She was merely an empty vessel then. Not anymore. Even you must be
aware that she acts on her own will now.

So cease your plotting. She will never join Chaos. She is sided with
Cosmos now.

No way I'll give it up! I swear I'm going to draw her powers out. Then
I'll be absolutely untouchable!
I wonder where that man went... I hope everyone's doing alright.

Eh, let them figure it out. They can use their swords if they want. Me,
I'm using my brains. I just know the crystal is close.
It's just... I have a bad feeling...
Do you still feel it? Is it up ahead?
It's here. Something powerful is close by.
I don't see anything unusual. Let me go take a look around and--
Terra, what are you doing? Don't you recognize me!?
Looks like I have no choice but to fight.
Terra! Terra! It's me! Are you alright? Terra!?
Stay out of the way. Her true powers are beginning to awaken.
What have you done to her!?

Who was the brute who chose not to ease the girl's pain, but to use his
sword instead? Who was the fool who dragged the unwilling girl here?

The girl knew in her heart all along. That is why she was so reluctant!
You have only yourself to blame for this. Your shallow cleverness got the best
of you! Curse your own ignorance and powerlessness. Nothing you can do can save
the girl!

I felt the fear in Terra's cry. She is in pain. The Cloud of Darkness
has taken hold of her with her curse...
Yes. Because you were overconfident of your powers.
Cosmos, you know how... You know how to save Terra, don't you?
You must defeat the Cloud of Darkness.

Her...? But I can't fight her... I don't fight against anyone I can't
beat... Oh, right! The crystal! I should be able to save Terra if I can get my
hands on the crystal... It has the power to save the world, right? Then I won't
have to fight anybody! Please, just tell me where I should go find the
crystal!

Avoiding conflict is certainly a choice. Few would say it is wrong.
But is that truly what is in your heart?

The crystal lights the way to what you seek. It is yours if you look
inside your heart and follow what is most important to you. I'm afraid that is
all I can tell you.

Terra was her name, was it not? Unless the curse is lifted, she will
live only to fight for the Cloud of Darkness. When at last her strength fails
her, she will fall to some faceless foe. You cannot defeat the Cloud of
Darkness. You'd show wisdom in choosing to avoid her. Why do you hesitate? You
do not trust what your mind knows to be true?
If not to reason, then listen to your heart.

I know I have to save Terra. But how can I fight HER and win? Wait...
Yeah! That just might work...
She must be close. I can smell the stench of darkness...
Unconscious already... She's too fragile to be of any use.
Well, now. Have you not learned yet? Are you here to challenge us again?

I don't fight anyone that I can't defeat. I will do whatever you want. So
please, spare Terra's life.

So you have learned after all. Your decision is a wise one. Very well.
Then you shall serve us.
Prove yourself more useful than the girl.
I didn't think you'd be so gullible.

I finally got it. I was a fool to defy my heart, just to bind myself to
reason. I will protect Terra with my own strength. That's what's most important
to me! Don't get me wrong--I still won't fight against anyone I can't beat. But
I've decided in my heart to fight. That's why I'm going to beat you!
You have already taken such a beating...
What awaits when you awake is always--
She merely fainted. The girl drew too deeply upon her powers.
You again... You're not getting near Terra!
I admire your resolve. You should protect her.

For all the awesome power she wields, the girl fears what she is. You
must be her shield, her pillar of support.
I don't need you to tell me that!

I suppose not. You know the path that lies before you. And the crystal
lights the way to that which you seek.
Terra... Everything is alright. I'll be right here, so you can rest.
Because I'll protect you. But...maybe for a minute, I'll--

BOOOOOO!!! How could she not draw out the girl's powers? That hag isn't
worth the dirt on the bottom of my boots! This is why I hate working with
amateurs. Guess it's my turn to stir up some trouble!
Why not break her now? So fragile...it would be simple.
I wanna have some fun! After all, she's a-- good ol' friend of mine!

(I thought if only I were diligent, what I sought would soon be mine.
Yet still, the true path eludes me. What must I do to find the crystal? The
world isn't waiting for me to--)

Lose yourself in the fog of doubt and reverie, and you will never
reach the crystal. It will forever remain but a dream.
I lose my way because it is a dream.
If you want to know the secret of the crystal, follow my shadow.

Are you alright? That was...Golbez, wasn't it? Isn't he sided with
Chaos?
Be that as it may...he's with the enemy. What did he say to you?

He said he knows the secret of the crystal-- that I should follow him
if I want it.

Cecil, this is hard for me to say... but lower your gard and the
